territorial_scope.description: Federal Brazilian bill amending two Brazilian federal laws, the Civil Code and the Copyright Law.

evidence.quote: Esta lei altera a Lei nº 10.406, de 10 de janeiro de 2002 - Código Civil, e a Lei nº 9.610, de 19 de fevereiro de 1998

summary.short: Brazilian bill PL 4025/2023 would amend the Civil Code and the Copyright Law (Lei 9.610/1998) on use of a living or deceased person's image and copyright arising from artificial intelligence. Presented 21/08/2023; awaiting rapporteur in the CCJC.
summary.long: The document is the Câmara dos Deputados portal page for PL 4025/2023, not the bill's operative text. According to its ementa, the bill amends the Civil Code (Lei 10.406/2002) and the Copyright Law (Lei 9.610/1998) on use of a person's image, living or deceased, and on copyright arising from use of artificial intelligence. The indexing terms refer to manipulation of images, authorisation for use, works generated by AI systems, copyright protection, and training of AI systems. Mechanisms, addressees, thresholds, obligations and penalties cannot be verified from this document and are not coded. Procedural record: presented 21/08/2023 by Dep. Marx Beltrão (PP/AL) under conclusive committee review. The Comissão de Cultura approved its rapporteur's opinion with a substitute on 17/12/2025. The CCJC designated a rapporteur on 28/05/2026, and three amendments to the project were presented by 16/06/2026. Status: awaiting the rapporteur's opinion in the CCJC.
